requirements.label: 128 Total Credits
requirements.hint: All College of Engineering BSE programs require 128 credit hours.

requirements.label: MATH 115: Calculus I
requirements.hint: Part of the 16 credit CoE mathematics core. AP calculus credit counts here automatically. Honors math sequences also satisfy this per the CoE Bulletin, use the adjust control if your credit posted under a different course number.

requirements.label: MATH 116: Calculus II
requirements.hint: Part of the 16 credit CoE mathematics core. AP calculus credit counts here automatically. Honors math sequences also satisfy this per the CoE Bulletin, use the adjust control if your credit posted under a different course number.

requirements.label: MATH 215: Multivariable Calculus
requirements.hint: Part of the 16 credit CoE mathematics core.

requirements.label: Linear algebra (MATH 214 or equivalent)
requirements.hint: DS-Eng requires linear algebra in place of MATH 216. MATH 214, 217, or 417 satisfies this per the DS-Eng program guide, and EECS 245 also counts per the official DS course lists.

requirements.label: Chemistry core
requirements.hint: Either CHEM 130 with the CHEM 125 and 126 labs, or CHEM 210 with the CHEM 211 lab for students who place into organic chemistry. Satisfactory AP chemistry credit also meets this per the CoE Bulletin, use the adjust control if that is your case.

requirements.label: CHEM 130 with labs 125 and 126
requirements.hint: General chemistry with both laboratory courses.

requirements.label: CHEM 210 and CHEM 211
requirements.hint: Organic chemistry path for students who place into CHEM 210. Placement here means no credit is given for CHEM 130.

requirements.label: PHYSICS 140: General Physics I
requirements.hint: CoE physics core. The honors sequence PHYSICS 160 also satisfies this.

requirements.label: PHYSICS 141: Elementary Lab I
requirements.hint: CoE physics core laboratory. The honors lab PHYSICS 161 also satisfies this.

requirements.label: PHYSICS 240: General Physics II
requirements.hint: CoE physics core. The honors sequence PHYSICS 260 also satisfies this.

requirements.label: PHYSICS 241: Elementary Lab II
requirements.hint: CoE physics core laboratory. The honors lab PHYSICS 261 also satisfies this.

requirements.label: ENGR 100: Introduction to Engineering
requirements.hint: A grade of C or better is required. Transfer students may substitute a course meeting the LSA first year writing requirement.

requirements.label: ENGR 101: Introduction to Computers and Programming
requirements.hint: A grade of C or better is required. For DS-Eng, ENGR 151, EECS 183, ROB 102, or EECS 180 AP credit also satisfies this per the DS-Eng program guide.

requirements.label: Intellectual Breadth (16 credits)
requirements.hint: 16 credits of liberal arts courses, meaning courses marked HU or SS that are not also marked BS, NS, or QR. ECON 101 and 102 count by explicit exception. Up to 4 credits of approved professional development courses from other U-M schools may also count, use the adjust control to include those.

requirements.label: Humanities minimum (3 credits)
requirements.hint: At least 3 of the 16 Intellectual Breadth credits must be humanities courses. Credit by test cannot be used for this minimum.

requirements.label: Upper level liberal arts minimum (3 credits)
requirements.hint: At least 3 of the 16 Intellectual Breadth credits must be liberal arts courses at the 300 level or higher. One course may satisfy both this and the humanities minimum.

requirements.label: General electives (15 credits)
requirements.hint: Free elective credits that bring the program to 128 total. Any U-M course counts.

requirements.label: Residency (50 credits at U-M Ann Arbor)
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule. At least 50 credits must be U-M Ann Arbor coursework, including at least 30 credits of 300 level or higher technical courses offered by the College of Engineering in Ann Arbor.

requirements.label: Introductory Data Science
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: DATASCI 101, STATS 250, STATS 280, IOE 265, or ECON 451, C or better. The DS-Eng program guide strongly recommends DATASCI 101.

requirements.label: Discrete Mathematics: EECS 203 or MATH 465
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: EECS 203 or MATH 465. C or better.

requirements.label: EECS 280: Programming and Introductory Data Structures
requirements.hint: C or better.

requirements.label: EECS 281: Data Structures and Algorithms
requirements.hint: C or better.

requirements.label: Probability and Statistics: STATS 412, 425, or 426
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: STATS 412, STATS 425 (also offered as MATH 425), or STATS 426 (also offered as MATH 426), C or better. STATS 250 may not fulfill this requirement.

requirements.label: STATS/DATASCI 413: Applied Regression Analysis
requirements.hint: C or better.

requirements.label: Capstone Experience
requirements.hint: One approved DS capstone course of 4 credits, C or better, typically taken senior year. Per the DS-Eng capstone list, EECS 442 leaves the list starting Fall 2027, EECS 447 joins starting Winter 2027, and thesis or independent study routes such as EECS 443 or STATS 489 need pre-approval from a Data Science advisor.

requirements.label: Machine Learning and Data Mining: EECS 445 or STATS 415
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: EECS 445 or STATS 415, now offered as DATASCI 415. C or better. EECS 545 cannot fulfill this requirement, and students cannot earn credit for both EECS 445 and EECS 545.

requirements.label: Data Management and Applications: EECS 484 or 485
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: EECS 484 or EECS 485. C or better.

requirements.label: Data Science Application Elective
requirements.hint: One course from the approved Application Electives list, C or better, per the DS-Eng Application Electives list (retrieved July 2026). Select CSE 401X study abroad courses can also count with help from the advising office, and undergraduates are not guaranteed seats in graduate level courses.

requirements.label: Advanced Technical Electives (4 credits)
requirements.hint: At least 4 of the 19 technical elective credits must come from the Advanced Technical Electives list, C or better, per the DS-Eng elective lists (retrieved July 2026). All 500 level EECS courses need pre-approval, and a course used for the capstone cannot also count here.

requirements.label: Advanced Statistical Analysis Electives (4 credits)
requirements.hint: At least 4 of the 19 technical elective credits must come from the Advanced Statistical Analysis Electives list, C or better, per the DS-Eng elective lists (retrieved July 2026). The same course cannot count toward more than one elective category.

requirements.label: Flexible Technical Electives (11 credits to reach 19 total)
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule. The remaining technical elective credits to reach 19 total come from the pre-approved Flexible Technical Electives list of courses at the 200 level or higher, or from the two advanced lists, with at most 4 credits of directed or independent study, and EECS 201 is a recommended option.

requirements.label: EECS 496: Major Design Experience Professionalism
requirements.hint: EECS 496 or EECS 295 per the DS-Eng program guide. Approved equivalents include COMPFOR 111, CSE 543, ENGR 499 section 002, and approved special topics sections.

requirements.label: TCHNCLCM 300: Technical Communication for EECS
requirements.hint: Must be taken in a term before the capstone.

requirements.label: Technical Writing: TCHNCLCM 400 level or STATS 404
requirements.hint: Per the DS-Eng program guide the standard options are TCHNCLCM 497, STATS 404, or STATS 485, taken in the same or a later term as the capstone. Using STATS 485 for both this and the capstone requires 3 additional advanced technical elective credits.

requirements.label: Major Total Credits: 46 Credits
requirements.hint: Minimum 46 credits in the major, prerequisites excluded, counted against the official course lists used by the rows above. Flexible technical elective credits from outside those lists also count toward the total, use the adjust control to include them.
